purpose: Teach: 今や/いったん/実物/新品/ため息/吹く/丸い/酷い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃と比べて、本気で、絶対、今や、絶対、便利な時代、絶対、ね、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, when you were young compared to now — this really is a convenient age, isn't it? Do you remember?
lines.style: Gentle, reaching back. Soft opening. Warm curiosity in the question. Pause before the final 'remember' — inviting her into shared memory, not testing her.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、いったん、絶対、外に出ると、絶対、帰宅、絶対、遅かったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes. When I was young, when your grandfather would go outside, he'd always come home late. You remember that, don't you dear?
lines.style: Voice settling into memory. Tender, almost singing the words. A small smile lives in the voice. Speaking to him like she's letting him in on an old, beloved secret.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさん、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、実物、絶対、をいつも、絶対、見せてくれたわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, Gran always used to show your father real things, didn't she? Do you remember?
lines.style: Softer now. Reflective. He's not reaching back—he's describing what he sees when he closes his eyes. Slight wonder under the words.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、新品、絶対、の、絶対、洋服、絶対、嬉しそうにしたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When I was young, your grandfather would look so happy in his new clothes. You remember that, don't you dear?
lines.style: Quiet delight in the memory. Voice brightens slightly on 'happy' and 'new clothes.' Speaking as if she's watching it happen again. Intimate, like she's sharing something precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、ため息、絶対、つかなかったぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your father never sighed. Do you remember that, Gran?
lines.style: Statement of fact, but said with gentle wonder. Slight emphasis on 'never'—a gift he's recognizing now. Wondering tone, not testing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、外で、絶対、風が、絶対、吹く、絶対、と、絶対、お祖父ちゃんと、絶対、お庭に出たわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When I was young, whenever the wind blew outside, your grandfather and I would go out to the garden together. Do you remember that, dear?
lines.style: Lyrical, almost dreamy. Pace slow and unhurried. The wind and the garden live in her voice. Contentment underneath. She's not asking if he remembers—she's inviting him to see it too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんの、絶対、丸い、絶対、お顔、絶対、お父さん、絶対、好きだったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, I loved your grandmother's round face so much. Do you remember?
lines.style: Tender admission. Vulnerable underneath—a confession of something he's carried. Slight catch before 'loved,' like he's choosing to say it out loud now.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、夏の暑さ、絶対、酷い、絶対、年、絶対、ありましたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When I was young, there were summers when the heat was absolutely dreadful, weren't there? Do you remember that, dear?
lines.style: Reflective, drawing close. Voice softens into memory. Slight weight on 'dreadful'—acknowledging the difficulty without complaint. Fades gently at the end, like a door closing on a room she's visited many times.
